DAY_SLICE_ADDRESSING.*** DA WROTE A CANONICAL FORM OF ITS OWN: my first implementation gave 26f02bdab1814668 for 09-07 where the instrument gives 7eb54006ebfa1029 -- THE SAME 2,016 RECORDS, A DIFFERENT DIGEST. The count is convention-free and matched; the digest cannot match a canonicalisation nobody wrote down. That is exactly the second-convention failure this lane was told to avoid, committed by me and caught by DE naming the existing function. The module now IMPORTS the definition and REFUSES BY NAME where it cannot reach it, rather than restating it.
DAY_SLICE_ADDRESSING.THE_RULINGS_CLAIM_PROVEN_ON_REAL_DATA: 09-07's cells recorded THREE different whole-file snapshots -- 45,877 / 45,932 / 46,290 records, whole-file shas 1e9500d0 / 4f0fc39a / 172a9307 -- and ALL THREE give the SAME day slice 7eb54006ebfa1029 over 2,016 records. Day one's two arms disagree on the whole file and agree exactly on the slice. That is the ruling's central claim, measured rather than argued.
